name: Check Destiny endpoints
command: set -u; for host in destiny.whatbox.ca upload-assistant.destinyhdd.box.ca upload-assistant.whatbox.ca; do echo "$host"; getent ahostsv4 "$host" | head -2 || true; for scheme in http https; do code=$(curl -4 -k -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 8 "$scheme://$host:12345/api/health" 2>/dev/null || true); echo "$scheme:$code"; done; done
description: Check likely public Destiny WebUI hostnames and ports after the HDD slot migration.
